title: Normalized comparison of ordinary tensor models preserves chi
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme X. For two normalized Tensor records t and s [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], there is an isomorphism e:t.ordinary.tensor≅s.ordinary.tensor whose restriction to flat-term K-flat representatives carries t.ordinary.representative to s.ordinary.representative and which satisfies e.hom≫s.chi=t.chi. No constructibility or completeness condition is imposed on the two input derived objects.

source.place: Coefficient presentation of the projection map; the explicit quotient augmentation is the one of Bhatt--Scholze, Definition 3.4.10 and Lemma 6.5.5, as retained in def-sf-projection-tensor-coefficient-comparison

proof.text: The flat-term K-flat subcategory localizes to the entire derived category. Use fully faithful precomposition along its product localization to lift the ratio of the representative isomorphisms to e. The preimage equation gives the representative normalization.

The two actual augmentation chains coincide by their prescribed product and shifted coordinates. Restrict the desired chi equation to representatives. Insert the two canonical completion equations, use equality of the chains, and cancel the representative isomorphisms. Faithfulness proves the equation on the derived categories.

lean.statement:
theorem models_comparison (t s : OpenFactorCoherence.Tensor l E X) :
    ∃ e : t.ordinary.tensor ≅ s.ordinary.tensor,
      (∀ P Q : (proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)).FullSubcategory,
        t.ordinary.representative.hom.app (P, Q) ≫
          e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) =
        s.ordinary.representative.hom.app (P, Q)) ∧
      e.hom ≫ s.chi l E = t.chi l E
